description: The lsdocs organization's Renovate preset. Each repository's renovate.json extends it: "extends": ["local>lsdocs/.github"].

packageRules.description: Third-party Rust crates in one PR (majors in a PR of their own).
Third-party npm packages in one PR (majors in a PR of their own).
Third-party Python packages in one PR (majors in a PR of their own).
The organization's own crates and packages (crates.io, npm, PyPI) in one PR: a release wave updates them together.
The organization's own workflows and actions (lsdocs/.github, used at @main): no digest pins or updates; zizmor's ref-pin policy allows them.
GitHub Actions updates (pinned SHAs and their version comments) in one PR of their own.
mise tool versions (.config/mise*.toml) in one PR of their own.
Conventional Commits titles for every Renovate PR.
